title: The whole-derived native point-sections scalar square
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l. For every scheme W, there is a functor isomorphism comparison : quotientSections l E W ≅ coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E W ⋙ integralSections l E W satisfying exactly sectionsComparisonUnit l E W comparison, using the actual R-module-valued functors and unit equation of def-coef-support-point-sections-data. No finite-evaluation data, open tensor comparison or compact-support operation is asserted.

proof.text: The ordinary quotient-system sections factor through exact completed coefficient restriction. Apply unbounded derived direct-image composition to the ringed coefficient/point square, retain the constant R action, and normalize by the universal derived unit. This constructs comparison and comparison_unit. Scalar restriction need not preserve K-injectives: use K-flat inverse images and derived adjunction/composition instead.
